implementationBoundary.backend: Only paths explicitly enumerated by backendExecutionAuthority in the authority document may change.
implementationBoundary.frontend: Only generated synchronization, route/menu/shell, navigation-policy successor and Stage-A disclosure paths explicitly enumerated by frontendExecutionAuthority may change.
implementationBoundary.dependencyOrder: Frontend may prepare its read-only shell in parallel but must synchronize final generated authorization artifacts from the reviewed backend v52 output.
implementationBoundary.verification: Run each named bounded target once; after a failure rerun only the smallest failing target.
forbidden: frontend ACTION delegate, POST, step-up request or writable HRM-009 control
feature activation, tenant enrollment, customer data or production rollout
Platform creator, seed, request or deep-link mutation
download, revoke, verification, expiry or access/download audit expansion
mutation of authorization v1-v51 or migrations V1-V260

requiredExit: Both implementation branches are committed and pushed at exact reviewed heads.
Bounded verification evidence records first-pass and smallest-target correction outcomes without broad reruns.
Independent backend, frontend and evidence reviews close all P0 and P1 findings.
A separate append-only central admission decision names the exact accepted heads before any no-ff dwp-dev merge.
